ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms a peak request rate, headroom and the growth-forecast flag are declared; it does not test that the hardware sustains the load.
offer: Size capacity from a declared peak workload with explicit headroom and growth assumptions. A static configuration cannot prove that the hardware sustains the forecast.

minimal.reason: Declare the peak requests per second, at least 100. A lower figure is not a peak workload, so size from the real maximum.

mid.reason: Keep headroom of at least 30 percent. Running at the forecast leaves no room for error, so add margin.

maximal.reason: Set ignoring the growth forecast to false. Capacity sized for today fails next quarter, so include growth assumptions.

rule.reason: Declare the peak requests per second, at least 100. A lower figure is not a peak workload, so size from the real maximum.
